Thanks — ran a preliminary credit snapshot. Hypernova is investment-backed, cashflow appears healthy, but their AP team enforces Net-60 as standard. Two practical options:

1) Approve Net-60 + quarterly invoicing with conditions: signed PO for first quarter, limited credit hold if invoices exceed 90 days unpaid, and standard late-fee language in the Master Services Agreement. No change to pricing.

2) Alternatively, flip to Net-30 with a 5% prepayment on first invoice (discounted to keep economics) — this reduces our risk but they are adamant on Net-60.

Operational note: Quarterly invoice consolidation is doable, but we need to flag cash forecasting and connect Billing ops with Hypernova contact (ap@hypernova.com) to align invoice format and remittance.

I recommend option 1, subject to Vivek's sign-off for the extended DSO. If Vivek is ok, I will prepare the contract addendum and update the Quote.
